twistDescription: Line height loosening (intensity 3): Scaled all line-height values up by 1.35x. Endlesstools had extremely tight line heights (p: 18px/20px = 1.11 ratio, h1: 42px/46px = 1.10 ratio). The loosened values (h1: 62px, body: 32px, p: 27px, button/link: 19px) give the type system generous breathing room — shifting it from dense SaaS-utility toward a more refined, editorial feel while preserving Inter's clean functional character.

Easing curve swap (C, intensity 4): All 'ease-in-out' timing function values replaced with the springy back-ease cubic-bezier(0.68,-0.55,0.265,1.55). This injects elastic overshoot into Apple's otherwise rigid and symmetrical nav transitions — the ribbon drop, link color changes, and flyout panels now snap past their resting state before settling, creating unexpected personality within Apple's precision motion grammar.

Gap value scaling at intensity 4 (×1.6): all gap values scaled up to open breathing room between the layered product windows. 16px gaps become 26px, 32px slider gap becomes 51px, and the mixed 16px/8px gap becomes 26px/13px. This amplifies the editorial alternating-density rhythm central to Ready's floating-window layout language.

Twist D (Button padding shift, wider, intensity 4): The source system had extremely compressed button padding (1px vertical / 6px horizontal), which would produce unclickable, illegible controls. Applied +8px vertical and +16px horizontal to button padding only, bringing it to 9px / 22px — a comfortable, tactile target size. All other spacing values are unchanged.

Focus state enhancement (twist E, intensity 3): all interactive elements had outlineWidth set to '0px', making focus states invisible. Applied outlineWidth: '2px' uniformly across every state (default, hover, active) on all buttons, links, and navigation elements. Color values are unchanged — the outline draws from each element's existing outlineColor. This restores purposeful focus visibility and gives the precision-aviation aesthetic a properly engineered accessibility layer.

Twist D — Letter spacing on nav links at intensity 4: changed typography.letterSpacing from 'normal' to '0.1em'. The existing uppercase micro-typography at 0.75rem gains pronounced inter-character air, deepening the French luxury editorial register already present in the Hermes nav and pushing it toward haute couture territory.

Kinetic shift applied to the Hero Section paragraph — rewritten to foreground movement, velocity, and sequential energy (the arrival of cartoon hands from outside the frame, the stacked headline loading in color-block pulses, the CTA pair snapping into place) rather than describing the hero as a static architectural arrangement of flat color and centered type.
